The Rundown offers a sharp contrast of perspectives you won’t hear anywhere else, and a daily commentary you can't miss, we deliver the full picture of the day's biggest events.

item.title: What We Know About the Investigation into Rep. Ilhan Omar
item.description:
Rep. Ilhan Omar’s (D-MN) immigration history is facing fresh scrutiny after federal agents searched her Washington, D.C., home in October, with new reports detailing subpoenas to relatives. There are also reports that her congressional staffers have been requested to speak about the possibility they were told to change the birth year listed in public biographies. This week, a federal judge in Washington, D.C. may have paved the way for the way to unseal the criminal search warrant and related documents against Rep. Ilhan Omar. Where do we stand on this investigation?
FOX's Alexis McAdams speaks with Minnesota Republican Congressman Tom Emmer who says this isn't about background or beliefs, it is about facing consequences for criminal activity.

item.title: They Won Big. Can Democrats Actually Get Anything Done?
item.description:
Following sweeping midterm victories that are reshaping the balance of power in Washington, Democrats are already facing a fierce intraparty battle over leadership & leverage. FOX News Sunday Anchor and Host of the Livin’ the Bream Podcast Shannon Bream joins to discuss Hakeem Jeffries’ path to the Speaker’s gavel, Senate leadership dynamics involving Chuck Schumer, Chris Van Hollen, and John Fetterman’s 2028 outlook, and how a multi-day NSA outage and President Trump’s push for bipartisan deals could test both national security and party loyalty.
Astrophysicist Neil deGrasse Tyson joins White House correspondent Aishah Hasnie to investigate 1998 KY-26, a mysterious object orbiting the sun whose trajectory isn’t following standard laws of gravity. Drawing from his new book, Take Me to Your Leader: Perspectives on Your First Alien Encounter, Tyson explains how humans could use math to communicate with extraterrestrials and challenges congressional UFO whistleblowers to bring forward hard evidence. He also addresses growing vulnerabilities around artificial intelligence, warning that the United States, China, and Russia must agree on guardrails to keep AI from becoming our overlords.
PLUS, commentary by Dr. Marc Siegel, the Senior Medical Analyst for FOX News. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

item.title: President Trump's Historic Talks With Xi and Putin
item.description:
President Trump returning from China where he met with Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. The leaders agreed to increase the production and supply of refined petroleum products while reaffirming the importance of stable energy flows. President Trump says he was very happy the historic trilateral with the world's biggest nuclear powers, What wasn't spoken about was Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
FOX's Eben Brown speaks with Gordon Chang, China expert and best selling author of ‘Plan Red: China’s Project to Destroy America’ … and he has a new book coming out in March of next year (2027), ‘Apocalypse: The Coming Nuclear War’, who says its always good to have open lines of communication with adversaries but in terms of China, we need a different kind of strategy.

item.title: Is America Ready For AI Attacks?
item.description:
After a string of major tech outages that disrupted airlines, banks, and even Microsoft, Washington faces one urgent question: are these cascading outages just rushed maintenance, or a warning sign of AI accelerated cyber warfare?  Former acting CISA Director, President of Via Stella LLC, and Heritage Foundation Visiting Fellow Bridget Bean discusses the critical staffing shortages facing our top cyber defense agency, how nation-state adversaries like Iran and China are weaponizing AI tools to infiltrate critical infrastructure, and why securing America’s aging power and water grids requires harnessing AI on defense before it’s too late.
With Thanksgiving approaching, political disagreements could make the holiday dinner table more tense than festive. FOX News correspondent Alex Hogan speaks with Behavioral researcher and bestselling author Vanessa Van Edwards about practical tips for navigating difficult conversations, finding common ground, and keeping family relationships intact. She also explains how to recognize when a debate is getting too heated and why building connections starts with asking better questions.
PLUS, commentary by FOX News contributor Joe Concha.

item.title: How Real is the Potential of an Iranian 'Dirty Bomb' Attack?
item.description:
A new threat report describes the possibility of Iran developing plans for a "dirty bomb" attack on Washington, D.C., drawing a warning from President Trump that there would be overwhelming retaliation from the United States. A dirty bomb is a combination of conventional explosives with radioactive or biological material that would spread contamination without producing a nuclear explosion. This has been eyed as a potential attack for years now but experts do say that Iran could make a dirty bomb, but would need someone inside the United States with the level of expertise to handle the materials and carry out an attack
FOX's Eben Brown speaks with EJ Kimball, the director of policy and strategic operations for the U.S. Israel Education Association, who says weakening Iran has put them in a position to think of any kind of retaliatory attack on the United States

item.title: America’s Outage Anxiety & Trust Issues: Martha MacCallum on the ‘Consequential’ Years to Come
item.description:
After a week of widespread tech outages and glitches disrupting airlines, banks, and major software systems, concerns are growing over America’s aging infrastructure and national vulnerabilities. The Story host and executive editor Martha MacCallum joins to discuss what the recent disruptions reveal about systemic weak spots, explain why a growing wave of unaligned voters is upending traditional party politics, and share the inspiring first-person stories of everyday and military heroism featured in her new book, The Book of Valor.
President Trump heads to China for high-stakes meetings with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. Michael Pillsbury, FOX News contributor and member of the Pentagon’s Defense Policy Board, joins FOX News correspondent Lucas Tomlinson to discuss the possibility of a historic nuclear arms agreement, China’s growing military and AI capabilities, and whether the U.S. can maintain its global standing as Beijing and Moscow strengthen their partnership.
PLUS, commentary by Rich Zeoli, host of The Rich Zeoli Podcast.
PHOTO CREDIT: AP IMAGES
